# vendor/exmateria-spu-core

Shared FFT SPU + sequencer core. Vendored at publish time from
[ExMateria-SPU-Core](https://github.com/timbermania/ExMateria-SPU-Core)
so this repo builds standalone — no submodules, no companion clones.

Do not edit these files here. Upstream changes happen in the SPU-Core
repo (or the umbrella monorepo); re-publishing this repo refreshes the
snapshot.
